title: Sessions and Assistants are never blocked from opening sessions, except a 12-per-project cap the user can lift

requirements.text: A project session can open a session in another project (genlock and app)
A Subassistant can open a session in any project (genlock and app)
At the 12 cap, --over-cap with the user's words opens anyway, in genlock and in the app
A handoff or swap with checkpoint gaps still opens the fresh session, listing the gaps as warnings
Agent instructions describe the cap and --over-cap instead of 'hand off instead'

evidence: tests/run.mjs: 'a project session opens a session in another project, with no yes' passes (request project=other-project); app: openSessionsIfAsked accepts any store project, swift build ok (no AppModel unit test, eye-check after relaunch)
tests/run.mjs: subEnv open beta -> 'Opening a fresh session on beta' exit 0; app no longer drops a Subassistant's other-project open; swift build ok

tests/run.mjs: open at cap 4 refused naming --over-cap; with --over-cap opens, over_cap in request, over-cap event logged; spinoff launch same. swift AssistantRouteTests: allows(open:12,limit:12,overCap:'yes')==true, OpenRequest/SpawnRequest decode over_cap. 589/589 + 157 swift pass
tests/run.mjs: open --handoff with gaps exit 0, request written, prints 'fill these before your turn ends'; swap with gaps exit 0, swap.json written, lists 'T-Z2JA9 has no latest'-style gap
grep -c over-cap Voice.swift -> 3; line 361 says nothing stops an open except 12 per project, rerun with --over-cap; AGENTS.md + 3 continuity skill copies updated

text: All five met; tests green. App binary needs rebuild+relaunch to pick up cross-project and over-cap.
